hypothesis: SFT v2's regressions on arithmetic, JSON, injection and hierarchy follow from their realized exposure falling to 44-59% of v1.2's, when v1.3's larger dataset ran under the unchanged 1,226-update budget. Restoring exactly v1.2's realized draws for those skills, at the same budget, recovers them to non-inferiority with v1.2 while keeping most of v2's generalization gain. Alternative explanations stay open: interference from new formatting/instruction material, or fewer passes over new material (60% of v2's). GSM8K did not regress at 51% of v1.2's exposure, so exposure alone may not be the cause.
initialization: the frozen base (juniper1-base-v1, ckpt-000052034-336e5967) with a fresh optimizer; failed v2 weights are not continued
dataset_note: j1.sft-mix.v1 over frozen j1-sft-v1.3 (8584130b): one materialized epoch of exactly 78,464 draws. arith 13,228; json 7,994; injection 5,000; hierarchy 3,712; python 10,894; factuality 1,104 (each = v1.2 realized); gsm8k 2,539; uncertainty 1,581 (each = v2 realized); instruction following + formatting + grounded QA + multi-turn 32,412 (0.7638 passes, 60% of v2). No new admission, so v1.3's isolation and contamination checks carry over unchanged. Apache-2.0 is removed from the approved list.
eval_bundle_role: historical v1.3 test bundle: the predeclared DIAGNOSTIC set and paired regression comparison. Its outputs informed SFT v2 development, so it is not untouched confirmation.
confirmation_bundle_role: sealed final confirmation j1-sft-confirm-v3 (Data docs/sft/confirm_v3.md; separate-agent review APPROVE): 4,417 chat items, seed 20261015, same held-out design as v1.3. It excludes every item whose task keys occur in v1.3 train/dev/test or v1.2 train/dev/test, and every prompt identical to a v1.2 or v1.3 evaluation prompt. Fixed-pool sources (Wikidata facts, MBPP, HumanEval, OASST1) are absent; hierarchy has 1 item, python 91 and uncertainty 39, so those are gated only on the historical bundle. GSM8K items come from the public test pool and are reported only. Evaluated exactly once, at the final gate, after an ADVANCE diagnostic and the completed replications. confirm-v1 (054109e7) and confirm-v2 (4cde9608) were superseded before any use.

training.epochs: exactly one epoch of the materialized mixture (78,464 = 1,226 x 64; no remainder skipped)
training.rationale: identical to the v1.2 pilot and SFT v2. Only the dataset (mixture) differs, so the comparison with v2 isolates the mixture.

replication_rule: Seeds 2 and 3 run only after the diagnostic outcome is ADVANCE. STOP_FAILED or STOP_INSUFFICIENT ends this protocol. The seed is preserved and diagnosed, and nothing is tuned, re-run or re-seeded under this protocol.
candidate: the final checkpoint (update 1226) of seed 1. Seeds 2 and 3 enter the final rule. No checkpoint or seed is selected after scoring.

smoke.pass: bitwise A/B after a SIGTERM at update 15 and resume; corrupted and torn latest checkpoints are rejected and roll back to bitwise equality with A

baseline.description: the replicated v1.2-recipe candidates, paired by seed number

v2.description: the FAILED SFT v2 candidates (never promoted), used only for the new-capability non-inferiority comparison

statistics.seed_aggregation: seed mean of paired per-item differences; per-seed exact McNemar
statistics.limits: Paired item bootstrap treats items as independent. It does not model related task, entity or phrasing clusters. With three seeds, seed variation is bounded replication evidence, not a variance estimate. The diagnostic uses one seed.

primary.multiplicity: Holm over the two endpoints (largest per-seed exact McNemar p)
primary.clean_slice_rule: paired CI lower bound > 0 vs v1.2 on each clean slice (sensitivity file docs/posttrain/sft_v2_sensitivity_v1.json); historical bundle only
primary.pass: vs the same-seed v1.2 baseline: point improvement >= 0.20 (55% of v2's +0.365/+0.343), CI lower bound > 0.10, every seed improves, Holm p < 0.05

vs_v2.rule: PASS iff CI lower bound of (v2.1 - v2) > -0.15; FAIL iff point or CI upper bound < -0.15; otherwise INSUFFICIENT

auto.formula: margin = max(0.03, 2 * sample SD of the three v1.2 baseline seeds on the group)

noninferiority.rule: affirmative: PASS iff the paired CI lower bound of (v2.1 - v1.2) > -margin; FAIL iff point estimate or CI upper bound < -margin; otherwise INSUFFICIENT. Each group is gated separately; gains elsewhere never offset a regression.

auto.formula: margin = max(0.05, 2 * v1.2 baseline seed SD on the relation)

knowledge.rule: Chat answers vs v1.2 use the affirmative non-inferiority rule above. Separately, the candidate's own few-shot answers vs the frozen base's few-shot answers must not be significantly worse (exact McNemar p < 0.05, worse) in ANY seed; otherwise the relation FAILS. Retention is not inferred from an absence of evidence: an underpowered chat comparison is INSUFFICIENT.

gates.early_stop: dev loss rises at three consecutive dev evaluations

decision.diagnostic: --mode diagnostic, seed 1, historical bundle. ADVANCE iff every gate holds, every primary endpoint and clean slice passes, every vs_v2 and protected non-inferiority group is PASS, and no knowledge relation FAILS. Knowledge relations may be INSUFFICIENT at one seed and are carried to the final gate. STOP_FAILED on any failure. STOP_INSUFFICIENT if a protected or vs_v2 group is INSUFFICIENT.
decision.final: --mode final, seeds 1-3. The historical-bundle rules apply with seed means, plus the primary, vs_v2 and protected rules on the confirmation bundle, evaluated once. QUALIFIED_FOR_REVIEW iff everything passes. FAILED on any failure. Otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Never an automatic pass.
decision.promotion: none by this protocol; a QUALIFIED_FOR_REVIEW candidate still needs the personal-use (App) qualification and owner decision

evaluation_layout.root: FLOWBOX ~/j1post/eval (private; per-item scores are not committed)

test_access: Only the scorer reads answers. Engineers see per-item booleans and aggregates, never answer text. Confirmation answers stay sealed until the final gate, and confirmation generations are made only at that gate. Every access is recorded in docs/posttrain/sft_v21_test_access.jsonl.
app_conversation: DEFERRED to the personal-use qualification (directive section 10). This stage gates the automatic skills above and does not claim conversational or App-instruction usefulness.

environment.training_and_generation: FLOWBOX RTX 2060, fp32, TF32 off, deterministic algorithms, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 (as the v1.2 pilot and replications)
environment.scoring: FLOWBOX CPU, Data scorer at data_code_revision (sandboxed)

budget.note: local only; no paid compute under this protocol

storage: Runs go under ~/j1post/runs/v21 on the NVMe (about 8 GB free), keeping the final and recovery checkpoints. The final checkpoint is preserved to the HDD archive, which is below the backup tool's 21.5 GB reserve: a recorded owner decision is pending. Nothing existing is deleted.
rollback: juniper1-base-v1 remains canonical; every v2.1 run is a new lineage; all runs, failures and rejected checkpoints are preserved

confirmation.rule: primary endpoints vs v1.2 (same rule as the historical bundle), vs_v2 on the primary endpoints, and affirmative non-inferiority on the listed groups, with auto margins from the three v1.2 baseline seeds on this bundle. A gated group with fewer than min_n items cannot PASS: a would-be PASS becomes INSUFFICIENT, so the final outcome is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. The registered gated groups all have at least 300 items in confirm-v3. Groups in reported_groups are reported only.

exposed_items.use: reported_fresh rows (reported, not gated) for every protected group: the same comparison without the 467 historical test items whose task keys appear in j1-sft-v1.2 train/dev (math 102, instruction following 97, uncertainty 162, hierarchy 48, python 57, json 1)

hypothesis_limits_amendment_1: Two further explanations, recorded before any v2.1 output: (a) baseline exposure. 467 historical test items share task keys with j1-sft-v1.2 train/dev, which the v1.2 baseline trained on and no v1.3-based arm can. On those items v2 - v1.2 is much more negative than on fresh items: hierarchy -0.319 vs -0.070, arithmetic -0.225 vs -0.136, Python -0.099 vs -0.024, in-distribution IF -0.258 vs +0.324. Injection and JSON have no such overlap. Part of v2's measured regression is therefore baseline memorization, which no mixture can repair. This bias works against v2.1, so it cannot produce a wrong pass, and the gates are unchanged. (b) repetition. Matching v1.2's draws on fewer unique v1.3 episodes means more passes per episode than v1.2's 2.0 (arithmetic 2.90, JSON 2.67, injection 2.5), an uncontrolled factor.
